eligible_labels: Builtin integer 0..7; 255 invalid; nonempty rectangular list/tuple grid
thinning: Zhang-Suen two synchronous subiterations; retain original surviving labels; record terminating (0,0) round
graph: All eight neighbors, simple undirected physical-pixel graph; maximal degree-2 trails and isolated nodes
return_to_start_junction: Closed returning trail; no repeated closing physical ID
canonical_order: Open forward/reverse lexicographic minimum; closed rotation/reverse minimum; sort sequences before assigning chain IDs
sampling: Axis 1000 and diagonal 1414; each marker 2000*k strictly below total selects first reached actual node; open endpoints retained; closed closing edge may select first node; deduplicate in chain order
ownership: Lowest chain ID among chains sampling this physical pixel; zero-owned chains retained
weighting: Global owned-sample bbox integer 4x4 grid; exact LCM positive weights; denominator occupied_cells*LCM
whole_template_without_owned_samples: Input contract error, including when thinning erases all nodes
extract_chains_boundary: Operate on exactly supplied grid without re-thinning or asserting a thinning fixed point
sample_chain_boundary: Validate unique adjacent physical IDs and chain metadata, but graph maximality and provenance are outside this API
